description: Every Marine a rifleman, and you were the genuine article: an 0311 with an M27 and an opinion about everyone else's trigger discipline.  Semper fi.  The Corps would want the line held.
The squad's automatic rifleman: same M27, more magazines, a bipod, and the standing order to make the enemy's heads stay down.  Semper fi.  Volume is a kind of fidelity.
An 0331 with a full-size M240 and the upper-body strength to prove it.  The gun goes where the squad leader points and the problem stops being a problem.  Semper fi.
An 0341 off the 81s: hang the round, cut the charge, and put steel on a grid square you'll never see.  The tube breaks down to man-portable, which is currently very relevant.  Semper fi.
An 0351 with a SMAW: bunkers, armor, and load-bearing walls all answer to the same backblast.  Semper fi.  Mind the area behind you.
Doc.  Navy by paycheck, Marine by adoption, and the first name screamed in every bad moment of the deployment.  Semper fi - they'd say it about you, which is the higher compliment.

You led a Force Reconnaissance team: the Corps' own deep eyes, conventional on paper and anything but in practice.  Celer, silens, mortalis - swift, silent, deadly.  Two out of three is now the whole world's job description; you still hold all three.
